JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
GROUP BY i.institution_name, egt.name_zh
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 6
ORDER BY 成员去重数量 DESC;

SELECT 
    egm.party_id AS member_customer_id,
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) AS group_count
FROM exposure_group_member egm
JOIN party p ON egm.party_id = p.party_id
GROUP BY egm.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) >= 2
ORDER BY group_count DESC, member_customer_id ASC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS 主体编号,
    p.display_name AS 主体名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.relation_id) AS 关联关系条数,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) AS 借款合同笔数
FROM party p
JOIN party_relation pr 
    ON (pr.source_party_id = p.party_id OR pr.target_party_id = p.party_id)
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc 
    ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
    AND rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方'
LEFT JOIN credit_agreement ca 
    ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'CORPORATE'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ca.agreement_id) > 0
ORDER BY 关联关系条数 DESC;

SELECT 
    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    p.display_name AS 客户名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.exposure_group_id) AS 所属集团数量
FROM party p
JOIN party_relation pr 
    ON p.party_id = pr.source_party_id
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc 
    ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
    AND rtc.relation_name_zh = '影子股东'
JOIN exposure_group_member egm 
    ON p.party_id = egm.party_id
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 所属集团数量 DESC, p.party_id ASC;

SELECT 
    pr.relation_id,
    pr.source_party_id,
    pr.target_party_id,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM credit_agreement ca1 WHERE ca1.borrower_party_id = pr.source_party_id) AS source_loan_count,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM credit_agreement ca2 WHERE ca2.borrower_party_id = pr.target_party_id) AS target_loan_count
FROM party_relation pr
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON pr.relation_type = rtc.relation_type
WHERE rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方'
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM credit_agreement ca1 WHERE ca1.borrower_party_id = pr.source_party_id)
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM credit_agreement ca2 WHERE ca2.borrower_party_id = pr.target_party_id)
ORDER BY (source_loan_count + target_loan_count) DESC;

SELECT c.collateral_id, c.asset_label, c.collateral_type
FROM collateral_asset c
WHERE c.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM collateral_link cl
      WHERE cl.collateral_id = c.collateral_id
        AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
  )
ORDER BY c.collateral_id ASC;

SELECT 
    g.guarantor_party_id AS 保证人编号,
    p.display_name AS 保证人名称,
    ROUND(SUM(g.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS 有效保证责任合计,
    ROUND(COALESCE(loan_balance.self_loan_balance, 0), 2) AS 自身贷款金额,
    ROUND(SUM(g.guaranteed_amount) - COALESCE(loan_balance.self_loan_balance, 0), 2) AS 超额担保金额
FROM guarantor_commitment g
JOIN party p ON g.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS self_loan_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
      AND lbs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM loan_balance_snapshot)
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
) loan_balance ON g.guarantor_party_id = loan_balance.borrower_party_id
WHERE g.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND g.effective_to IS NULL
GROUP BY g.guarantor_party_id, p.display_name, loan_balance.self_loan_balance
HAVING SUM(g.guaranteed_amount) > COALESCE(loan_balance.self_loan_balance, 0)
ORDER BY 超额担保金额 DESC;

SELECT 
    g.guarantor_party_id AS 保证人编号,
    p.display_name AS 保证人名称,
    g.guaranteed_amount AS 保证金额,
    g.status AS 保证状态
FROM guarantor_commitment g
JOIN party p ON g.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE g.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND g.guarantor_party_id IN (
      SELECT DISTINCT ca.borrower_party_id
      FROM loan_drawdown ld
      JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
      JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
      WHERE lbs.overdue_principal > 0
  )
ORDER BY g.guaranteed_amount DESC, g.guarantor_party_id ASC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name,
    ma.obligor_party_id AS final_debtor_id,
    COALESCE(SUM(ls.overdue_principal), 0) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
LEFT JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ma.obligor_party_id = ld.agreement_id
LEFT JOIN loan_balance_snapshot ls ON ld.loan_id = ls.loan_id
WHERE phs.lookthrough_depth > 0
  AND ma.obligor_party_id IS NOT NULL
  AND ma.obligor_party_id IN (
      SELECT DISTINCT ca.borrower_party_id
      FROM credit_agreement ca
      JOIN loan_drawdown ld2 ON ca.agreement_id = ld2.agreement_id
      JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld2.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
      WHERE lbs.overdue_principal > 0
        AND ca.institution_id = wp.issuer_institution_id
  )
GROUP BY wp.product_name, ma.asset_name, ma.obligor_party_id
ORDER BY wp.product_name ASC, total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT 
    sc.security_type AS 担保方式,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sc.security_id) AS 担保合同笔数,
    ROUND(SUM(sc.secured_amount), 2) AS 被担保金额合计
FROM security_agreement sc
JOIN secured_obligation so ON sc.security_id = so.security_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN status_catalog st ON st.entity = 'credit_agreement' AND st.status_code = ca.status
WHERE st.name_zh = '有效'
GROUP BY sc.security_type
ORDER BY 被担保金额合计 DESC;

SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    ROUND(ca.contract_amount, 2) AS contract_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cl.collateral_id) AS collateral_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.guarantor_party_id) AS guarantor_count
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN secured_obligation so ON ca.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
JOIN security_agreement sa ON so.security_id = sa.security_id 
    AND sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
LEFT JOIN collateral_link cl ON sa.security_id = cl.security_id 
    AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
LEFT JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id 
    AND gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, p.display_name, ca.contract_amount
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cl.collateral_id) > 0 AND COUNT(DISTINCT gc.guarantor_party_id) > 0
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count,
       ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_contract_amount
FROM institution i
JOIN exposure_group eg ON i.institution_id = eg.institution_id
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
WHERE eg.group_type = 'GROUP_CUSTOMER'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 5
ORDER BY total_contract_amount DESC;

SELECT 
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name,
    SUM(phs.carrying_amount - phs.fair_value) AS 倒挂金额合计,
    COUNT(*) AS 构成倒挂的持仓笔数
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN wealth_product wp ON phs.product_id = wp.product_id
WHERE phs.carrying_amount > phs.fair_value
GROUP BY wp.product_id, wp.product_name
HAVING SUM(phs.carrying_amount - phs.fair_value) > 0
ORDER BY 倒挂金额合计 DESC, wp.product_id ASC;

SELECT
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name,
    phs.lookthrough_depth,
    phs.carrying_amount,
    COALESCE(SUM(lbs.overdue_principal), 0) AS overdue_principal_total
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN wealth_product wp ON phs.product_id = wp.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
JOIN party p ON ma.issuer_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id IN (
    SELECT ca.agreement_id
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
      AND ca.institution_id = wp.issuer_institution_id
)
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
WHERE phs.lookthrough_depth >= 3
    AND ma.issuer_party_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name,
    phs.lookthrough_depth,
    phs.carrying_amount,
    phs.holding_id
ORDER BY
    phs.lookthrough_depth DESC,
    phs.holding_id ASC;

SELECT 
    cl.collateral_id,
    COUNT(*) AS first_lien_valid_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN cl.pledge_ratio > 0.60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS over_60_count
FROM collateral_link cl
WHERE cl.lien_priority = 1
  AND cl.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY cl.collateral_id
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY over_60_count DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    fs.total_assets,
    fs.total_liabilities,
    fs.net_assets,
    fs.annual_revenue
FROM institution i
JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
ORDER BY fs.annual_revenue DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(
        CASE 
            WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN fs.total_assets > 0 THEN fs.total_assets ELSE 0 END) = 0 
            THEN NULL 
            ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN fs.total_liabilities > 0 THEN fs.total_liabilities ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / 
                 SUM(CASE WHEN fs.total_assets > 0 THEN fs.total_assets ELSE 0 END) 
        END, 4) AS debt_to_asset_ratio
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN financial_snapshot fs 
    ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY debt_to_asset_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(cs.tier1_capital * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets, 4) AS core_tier1_capital_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE cs.tier1_capital IS NOT NULL 
  AND cs.risk_weighted_assets IS NOT NULL 
  AND cs.risk_weighted_assets != 0
ORDER BY core_tier1_capital_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(c.net_capital * 1.0 / f.total_assets, 6) AS net_capital_to_assets_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN capital_snapshot c ON c.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN financial_snapshot f ON f.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE f.total_assets IS NOT NULL AND f.total_assets > 0
ORDER BY net_capital_to_assets_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(fs.annual_revenue, 2) AS revenue,
    ROUND(fs.annual_revenue * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(fs2.annual_revenue) FROM financial_snapshot fs2 WHERE fs2.party_id LIKE 'PTY-%') * 100, 2) AS revenue_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE fs.annual_revenue * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(fs2.annual_revenue) FROM financial_snapshot fs2 WHERE fs2.party_id LIKE 'PTY-%') > 0.15
ORDER BY revenue_ratio DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS mismatch_count
FROM managed_asset ma
JOIN institution i ON ma.originator_institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE ma.internal_rating IS NOT NULL 
  AND ma.external_rating IS NOT NULL 
  AND ma.internal_rating != ma.external_rating
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY mismatch_count DESC;

SELECT 
    ma.valuation_method,
    ROUND(SUM(phs.carrying_amount), 2) AS total_carrying_amount
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN managed_asset ma ON phs.asset_id = ma.asset_id
GROUP BY ma.valuation_method
ORDER BY total_carrying_amount DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS account_count,
       ROUND(SUM(td.opening_principal), 2) AS total_principal
FROM institution i
JOIN account a ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN term_deposit td ON td.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_principal DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(td.account_id) AS deposit_count
FROM institution i
JOIN account a ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
JOIN term_deposit td ON a.account_id = td.account_id
WHERE td.annual_interest_rate > 3
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY deposit_count DESC;

SELECT 
    so.authority_level,
    COUNT(DISTINCT so.staff_id) AS operator_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) AS staff_count
FROM service_operator so
JOIN staff_member sm ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
WHERE sm.employment_type = '固定雇佣'
  AND so.operator_kind = '柜面'
  AND so.authority_level IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY so.authority_level
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) >= 10
ORDER BY operator_count DESC, so.authority_level ASC;

SELECT 
    ou.unit_name AS 机构名称,
    COUNT(td.account_id) AS 笔数
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON a.org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
WHERE td.maturity_on IS NOT NULL
  AND julianday(td.maturity_on) - julianday('2026-06-30') >= 0
  AND julianday(td.maturity_on) - julianday('2026-06-30') <= 30
GROUP BY ou.unit_name
ORDER BY 笔数 DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount), 2) AS under_provision_total,
    fs.net_assets,
    ROUND(SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount) * 1.0 / fs.net_assets * 100, 2) AS under_provision_pct
FROM institution i
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN provision_snapshot p ON p.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN party pt ON pt.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = pt.party_id
WHERE p.required_amount > p.recognized_amount
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, fs.net_assets
HAVING SUM(p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount) > 0
ORDER BY under_provision_pct DESC, i.institution_id ASC;

SELECT cg.grade_name_zh AS 风险分类名称, COUNT(rc.loan_id) AS 借据数量
FROM risk_classification rc
JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE cg.is_nonperforming = 1
  AND rc.classification_basis = 'MANUAL_REVIEW'
GROUP BY cg.grade_name_zh
HAVING COUNT(rc.loan_id) BETWEEN 60 AND 105
ORDER BY 借据数量 DESC, 风险分类名称 ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS bad_loan_count,
    SUM(ds.overdue_principal) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM institution i
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ds.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN risk_classification rc ON rc.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN classification_grade cg ON cg.grade_code = rc.grade_code
LEFT JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE ds.principal_overdue_days >= 90
  AND cg.is_nonperforming = 1
  AND fs.annual_revenue IS NOT NULL
  AND fs.annual_revenue > 0
GROUP BY i.institution_id, fs.annual_revenue
HAVING SUM(ds.overdue_principal) * 1.0 / fs.annual_revenue > 0.5
ORDER BY total_overdue_principal DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_principal_balance,
    cs.risk_weighted_assets,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.risk_weighted_assets * 100, 2) AS loan_to_rwa_percentage
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
LEFT JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
LEFT JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
LEFT JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON i.institution_id = cs.institution_id
WHERE ld.status = 'ACTIVE' 
  AND lbs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM loan_balance_snapshot)
  AND cs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM capital_snapshot)
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, cs.risk_weighted_assets
ORDER BY loan_to_rwa_percentage DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    pi.payment_mode AS 结算方式,
    COUNT(pi.instruction_id) AS 待执行指令数量
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN status_catalog sc ON sc.entity = 'loan_drawdown' AND sc.status_code = ld.status
WHERE pi.status = '待执行'
  AND sc.name_zh = '有效'
GROUP BY pi.payment_mode
HAVING COUNT(pi.instruction_id) > 45
ORDER BY 待执行指令数量 DESC, 结算方式 ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(p.record_id) AS exception_record_count,
    SUM(p.amount_value) AS exception_amount,
    c.net_capital,
    f.total_assets,
    ROUND(SUM(p.amount_value) * 1.0 / c.net_capital * 100, 4) AS exception_to_capital_pct
FROM prudential_metric_snapshot_v3 p
JOIN institution i ON p.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN capital_snapshot c ON c.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN financial_snapshot f ON f.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE p.exception_flag = 1
  AND p.event_code IN (SELECT event_code FROM regulatory_event_catalog WHERE rule_family = '审慎监管指标')
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name, c.net_capital, f.total_assets
HAVING COUNT(p.record_id) >= 8
ORDER BY exception_to_capital_pct DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT rsv3.record_id) AS 监管报送逾期记录数,
    ROUND(AVG(ls.principal_balance), 2) AS 台账平均金额,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.required_amount > p.recognized_amount THEN p.loan_id END) AS 拨备不足借据数,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN p.required_amount > p.recognized_amount THEN p.required_amount - p.recognized_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS 拨备缺口金额
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN credit_agreement ca ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
LEFT JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
LEFT JOIN loan_balance_snapshot ls ON ld.loan_id = ls.loan_id
LEFT JOIN provision_snapshot p ON ld.loan_id = p.loan_id
LEFT JOIN regulatory_submission_event_v3 rsv3 ON i.institution_id = rsv3.institution_id
    AND rsv3.event_code IN (SELECT event_code FROM regulatory_event_catalog WHERE rule_family = '监管报送')
    AND rsv3.status_code = '逾期未完成'
WHERE p.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM provision_snapshot)
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT rsv3.record_id) >= 25
ORDER BY 拨备缺口金额 DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cf.facility_id) AS credit_facility_count,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN gce.exception_flag = 1 THEN gce.amount_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS governance_exception_amount,
    ROUND(AVG(gce.ratio_value), 4) AS avg_governance_ratio
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN credit_facility cf ON i.institution_id = cf.institution_id
LEFT JOIN governance_control_record_v3 gce ON i.institution_id = gce.institution_id
WHERE gce.event_code IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN gce.exception_flag = 1 THEN 1 END) >= 5
ORDER BY governance_exception_amount DESC, i.institution_name ASC;

SELECT 
    p.display_name AS 客户名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.target_party_id) AS 关联目标主体数,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.relation_type) AS 关系种类数,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rt.relation_name_zh != '非关联方' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS 非非关联方关系笔数
FROM party p
JOIN party_relation pr ON p.party_id = pr.source_party_id
LEFT JOIN relation_type_catalog rt ON pr.relation_type = rt.relation_type
WHERE p.party_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT subject_id 
    FROM related_transaction_record_v3 
    WHERE exception_flag = 1
)
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY 关联目标主体数 DESC, 关系种类数 DESC, 客户名称 ASC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.card_id) AS valid_card_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.holder_party_id) AS card_holder_count,
    ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ore.exception_flag = 1 THEN ore.amount_value ELSE 0 END), 0), 2) AS operational_risk_exception_amount,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN ore.status_code = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 END) AS operational_risk_valid_count
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN account a ON i.institution_id = a.institution_id
LEFT JOIN payment_card pc ON a.account_id = pc.settlement_account_id AND pc.status = 'ACTIVE'
LEFT JOIN operational_risk_event_v3 ore ON i.institution_id = ore.institution_id AND ore.status_code = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT wp.product_id) AS 在售产品数,
    SUM(wp.actual_raise_amount) AS 实际募集合计,
    COUNT(pce.record_id) AS 产品行为记录数,
    ROUND(AVG(pce.ratio_value), 4) AS 平均比值
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN wealth_product wp ON i.institution_id = wp.issuer_institution_id AND wp.status = '在售'
LEFT JOIN product_conduct_event_v3 pce ON i.institution_id = pce.institution_id AND pce.exception_flag = 1
WHERE pce.record_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(pce.record_id) >= 2
ORDER BY 实际募集合计 DESC;

SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ma.asset_id) AS 底层资产数,
    ROUND(SUM(ma.issued_amount), 2) AS 发行金额合计,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cl.status = '有效' THEN cl.collateral_link_id END) AS 托管有效记录数,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN cl.status = '有效' AND cl.exception_flag = 1 THEN cl.pledged_amount END), 2) AS 异常金额合计
FROM managed_asset ma
JOIN institution i ON ma.originator_institution_id = i.institution_id
LEFT JOIN collateral_link cl ON cl.collateral_id = ma.asset_id
WHERE cl.status = '有效'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN cl.exception_flag = 1 THEN 1 END) >= 2
ORDER BY 发行金额合计 DESC, i.institution_name ASC;
